Every pin that must be connected appears in exactly one net; say which pins are left unconnected and why.
3. Build order: which parts to place first, which wires, which power symbols, which labels, and what to check on screen after each group.

{"parts": [{"ref": "R1", "symbol": "Device:R", "value": "10k"}, ...],
 "nets": [{"label": "GND", "pins": ["R1.2", "Q1.1"]}, {"label": null, "pins": [...]}, ...]}

End with one paragraph on the design choices you made where the task was open.
